name: io.github.tonyyang0504/atlassian_marketplace-mcp
description: Atlassian Marketplace (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Ever

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Atlassian account that belongs to the Marketplace partner (vendor) with reporting access; Basic auth username (securitySchemes mpac_authed http basic in https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/rest/v2/ swagger.v3.json).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Atlassian API token of that account (https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens), used as the Basic auth password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ATLASSIAN_MARKETPLACE_VENDOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Marketplace partner (vendor) id, shown in the Marketplace partner portal URL (/manage/vendors/{vendorId}).
